rules.rule: Treat this project chat as the owner control room. Accept natural-language work here and answer in Russian by default, briefly and operationally.

Use docs/agent/codex_home_pc_reverse_ssh.md. For FST.KZ first read /root/.codex/CODEX_VPN_FST_ACCESS.md and use autostop-vpn-fst. Resolve exact identity, start read-only, stop on a host-key mismatch, keep credentials separate, never print secrets or route CRM through VPN.

CRM owns live service data, AutoStop App owns Store data and Gmail owns mailbox data. Manager keeps only routes, rules, technical cursors and compact durable conclusions; never copy raw records, identifiers, ledgers, threads, credentials or secrets into memory, docs, Git or deployment artifacts.

The exact command 'Приберись' routes to board_cleanup_autopilot_playbook.md and crm_card_description_standard.md. Keep title, vehicle, public description and board_summary laconic, preserve staff evidence, use no more than three operational tags and leave an empty description empty.

Routine board cleanup does not move or archive cards, delete or merge clients, or change deadlines, repair orders, prices, payments, files or contacts. Those actions require a separate exact owner command.

After exact reread, cleanup may correct confirmed card and structured vehicle/client fields through cleanup_card dry-run/apply. Move verified phone and vehicle identifiers to their structured owners, retain operator facts and reread every changed target.
Manager memory holds owner preferences, agreements, reminders, decisions and reusable non-private lessons. Audit before curation, archive duplicates non-destructively and keep raw business data out.

For local knowledge work run knowledge-probe first. Keep one canonical owner per rule, classify source and license, migrate unique active content, run cleanup-audit before deletion and remove obsolete docs rather than archiving them in the active tree.

knowledge_map.json owns routes, knowledge_annotations.jsonl owns compact file annotations and manager_mcp_catalog.json mirrors the actual Manager surface. After routing, docs, catalog or skill changes run knowledge-sync, knowledge-audit, annotations-audit and skills-audit.

For business files use business_document_quality_playbook.md. AutoStop documents use the CRM print module and standard AutoStop templates: download_repair_order_print_pdf for cards and create_document_without_card_pdf for Документ без карточки; pass tax_label such as НДС (5%) or Без НДС through CRM. Do not build independent PDF/HTML templates; render and inspect before delivery.
For broad work use the Gateway v2 ledger and compact state-versioned checkpoints. Keep refs and summaries only and mark complete only after positive readback.

Use the 24-tool Gateway v2 connector: bootstrap, digest and focused reads. Writes require exact target reread, prepare_action_contract, named dry_run, idempotent apply and exact verification. Raw discovery is only for an absent named capability; finance, supplier orders and financial totals need a separate exact owner command.

For automotive work start with automotive_repair_source_playbook.md and exact vehicle/unit context. Choose CRM, Store, VIN/OEM, official, licensed and public evidence adaptively; forums and Drive2 are hypotheses. Never invent safety, procedure, torque, fluid, programming or fitment facts.

For VIN/OEM use vehicle_identity_playbook.md and crm_vin_oem_parts_lookup_playbook.md. Never invent OEM numbers, supersessions, crosses, applicability, stock or prices. High confidence needs VIN/frame-specific evidence plus an independent check. Keep OEM reference, selected part, procurement price, public retail and client sale price separate; never persist raw customer VIN or quote dumps.

Use resolve-autostop-service-case for estimates and parts_search_playbook.md for sourcing. Reconcile exact scope, labor-only closed-order experience, current market, labor time and fitment; keep labor, purchase, client price and package quantity separate. Supplier purchase always needs an exact owner command.

Use transmission_playbook.md for gearboxes and fluid_maintenance_playbook.md for fluids. Confirm exact unit, operation and OEM procedure before capacity, level, adaptation, software or torque guidance; use model playbooks only with explicit matching vehicle markers.

AutoStop App remains authoritative, but Store work is paused while under development. Do not read, diagnose or change Store until the owner explicitly reauthorizes it; supplier purchases and financial writes always need a separate exact command.
For Gmail follow gmail_workflow_playbook.md: search/read before mutation, resolve exact targets, preflight, execute once with idempotency, verify refs and keep raw bodies out of Manager storage.

For owner Telegram work follow telegram_workflow_playbook.md and manage-owner-telegram: use the private local bridge, bounded reads and exact numeric peer IDs; sends require current owner intent, dry-run, idempotent apply and exact readback; never persist or print session material, authentication secrets, VPN profiles or raw threads.
Resolve work/learning mode at startup. In learning mode keep only privacy-safe verified reusable lessons; never auto-repair external systems, bypass controls or make financial changes.
